capabilities.name: Final Skill use summary
capabilities.function: Record each actually used Skill's exact name, applied step or action, and reason during the task, including delegated use; report one truthful summary in the final response without repeating Skill lists at startup or in progress updates.

capabilities.name: Action delivery and failure recovery
capabilities.function: Carry action requests through implementation and recovery; report delivered changes separately from verification, and stop affected work only for evidenced blockers after useful authorized routes are exhausted.

capabilities.name: Scoped parallel work and Monitor Mode
capabilities.function: Preserve each chat's title after its first confirmed naming; coordinate independent modules through authorized worker chats and shared modules/functions through same-chat subagents. Monitor Mode checks every five minutes, stays quiet on correct progress, briefly corrects drift and verifies agreed final evidence.

capabilities.name: Verification inside the task
capabilities.function: Use focused real behavior evidence or output readback bound to the actual source, artifact, consumer, configuration, runtime and provider; keep submission, backend and provider outcomes distinct and require user scope for whole-project runs.

capabilities.name: Ending memory branch
capabilities.function: Verify native deletion on the creating service or close out in the current chat without a new conversation. With a verified route, launch Ending Task | <project> in ordinary recents and immediately finish the parent after app acknowledgement. Ending alone reads its exact source chat, consolidates scoped Obsidian knowledge and due synthesis alongside resource cleanup, owns recovery, and must execute native self-deletion through the exposed tool or ending_conversation.py and verify all-provider list and rollout absence; archival stays deletion pending.

capabilities.name: Optional scoped recall
capabilities.function: Recall exact project/module/file/symbol entries from a centralized index; exclude stale method facts and expose cross-project links only as separate references.

capabilities.name: Reusable code and visual presentation preferences
capabilities.function: Preserve explicit code ownership, current async-result identity, guarded concurrent writes, configuration/cache identity and idempotent effects; every UI, PDF report, document and slide layout applies the shared readable UI baseline.

capabilities.name: Durable concise facts
capabilities.function: Keep effective current outcomes and useful history without raw prompts, secrets, or project mixing; read back writes.

capabilities.name: Recoverable managed installation
capabilities.function: Install into the official user root with locking, backup and recovery; automatically consolidate verified legacy copies, preserve project scope and private data, and report conflicts or permissions as pending.

capabilities.name: Global AGENTS preservation
capabilities.function: Normal installation preserves user AGENTS; explicit AGENTS installation creates a persistent restorable backup.

capabilities.name: Source, installation and publication
capabilities.function: Source owns maintained behavior; recoverable installation and authorized publication remain separate. Publish only selected task-owned files to the branch's configured upstream, merge fresh remote changes, preserve unrelated work/index, run release checks and read back the exact delivered ref.

capabilities.name: Portable host execution
capabilities.function: Host helpers use portable Python, native paths and noninteractive execution without forcing whole project builds.

capabilities.name: Measured simplification
capabilities.function: Optimize requested or recurring work with measured evidence; measure improvements without triggering routine benchmarks.

capabilities.name: Global resource coordination and Ending audit
capabilities.function: Execute indexed cleanup at task start, transition and finish: release own completed or obsolete disposable runs immediately and registered foreign disposable runs inactive at least 24 hours after fresh consumer checks. Detect project Cache naming violations, repair their producers and release obsolete material. Follow native owners for ledgers, worktrees, UI, process and network resources; preserve active, recovery and actual review/reuse needs.

capabilities.name: Concise current instructions
capabilities.function: Entries and references describe current responsibilities without repeated lifecycle ceremonies; behavioral tests replace obsolete workflow text checks.

capabilities.name: Automatic project AI index
capabilities.function: Only for the current task project, request consent before missing-index discovery or creation and repeat at later starts until complete; reference lookups in other projects skip index prompts, reads and writes without blocking; automatically maintain existing focused routes and concise root guidance, guard source/preimage updates and require Ending readback without inferred publication. Route all local code edits, including tests, through reviewed module/file/method anchors with bounded current-source excerpts and explicit related pointers; maintain touched routes without copying source or memory history.
